render_back.render_back_text: The initial level of each Section 1.3 Index is 1,000 on 5 August 2017, except for the Solactive Transatlantic Clean Energy EUR Index 50 AR, whose initial level on that date is 739.08. For any historical value of a Section 1.3 Index from the Live Date onward, the level is recorded in accordance with Article 8 of the BMR. Any published level for a period prior to the Live Date is back-tested.
